WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT ID,
           AVG(GOT) AS avg_got,
           AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
scored AS (
    SELECT ID,
           avg_got,
           avg_rbc,
           avg_got - AVG(avg_got) OVER () AS difference
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT ID, avg_got, avg_rbc, difference
FROM scored
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
